Fixes [LINK_REMOVED]

## Why

The built-in `ti` and `tt` converters produce values carrying `FixedTzOffset`. Pickling these values or their enclosing `Result` succeeds, but unpickling and `copy.deepcopy()` fail because the inherited `tzinfo` reduction does not provide the two required constructor arguments.

## Change

Provide `FixedTzOffset.__getinitargs__()` so the existing `tzinfo` pickle implementation can recreate the offset in minutes and its original name. Keep parsing, constructor requirements and saved instance-state handling unchanged. No runtime dependency is added.

Add parameterized regressions for UTC, positive/negative and numeric-zero offsets, datetime/time values, fractional seconds, naive controls and a standard-library timezone control. Check Result fields/spans, value and timezone types, offsets and names across deepcopy and every pickle protocol supported by the running interpreter. Only the strptime `%z` control receives the same Python-2 skip used in existing upstream tests; the affected `ti`/`tt` regressions remain enabled.

## Local verification

On Windows, CPython 3.13.15:

- Full configured pytest run, including module and README doctests: 180 passed, 1 pre-existing skip, no reported test warnings.
- With the identical final regression tests against the original production source: 42 failed, 138 passed, 1 skipped. The 42 failures are the required-offset/name reconstruction error. All original test identities and outcomes remain present and unchanged.
- `python -m mypy --check-untyped-defs --disallow-any-generics parse`
- `python -m mypy.stubtest parse`
- `python -m mypy tests/check_typing.py`
- Isolated development-environment dependency check passed.
- Independent AI re-review and parent replay agree for individual datetime/time values, named values and complete Results. The final re-review's probe has 81 observations per source tree; replay establishes reproducibility, not additional independent coverage.
- Wheel built successfully; packaged runtime source matches the final source hash, and parse/search/findall pickle/deepcopy smoke checks passed. Build-tool warnings concerning the existing universal-wheel configuration and disabled byte-compilation were retained.

Supplementary standard-library output probes also passed on existing CPython 3.9, 3.11, 3.12, 3.14 and PyPy 3.8 interpreters. These were bounded probes, not their complete test suites.

Python 2.7/3.7 and the complete cross-platform CI matrix were not executed. The legacy parameter condition was inspected statically; this is not a legacy-runtime pass. Type-check commands were run on 3.13, not the CI type job's 3.10.


## AI disclosure

Agent: Hermes Agent (Nous Research)
Model: gpt-6.1-sol (openai-codex)
Notes: AI-assisted implementation, regression tests and independent AI review. One review-found legacy test-boundary issue was corrected and re-reviewed. No human review or upstream CI success is claimed.
